tools.name: list_stores
tools.description: The Shopify stores this connection can use (each one approved in its own Shopify admin) and which one is the default. Pass `store` to any tool to work on another store.

tools.name: list_apps
tools.description: List the EA apps installed on the connected Shopify store, with plan, whether each is live on the storefront, and which ones accept drafts. Start here.

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: Performance numbers for one app (the same numbers as the app's Analytics page): e.g. bundle revenue, popup sign-ups, cart upsell sales. Aggregates only, no customer data.

tools.name: get_setup
tools.description: What is live right now in one app: offers, campaigns, bars, widgets and their key settings.

tools.name: get_suggestions
tools.description: Ideas for what to try next, based on this store's own setup and numbers. Without `app`: across all installed EA Apps.

tools.name: get_write_guide
tools.description: The fields an app accepts in create_draft / stage_changes (with an example). Call this before writing to an app. Apps that accept drafts: bundles (offers), popups (campaigns), sticky_cart (settings) and the bar apps (bar settings).

tools.name: list_items
tools.description: List the editable items of an app (bundle offers, popup campaigns, bars) with ids and status.

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: Full current settings of one item (in the write-guide field names), e.g. before changing it.

tools.name: list_drafts
tools.description: Drafts and unpublished changes made through AI tools for this store that are waiting to be published or discarded.

tools.name: preview_draft
tools.description: Show a draft or published change as a preview card (what shoppers will see, what changes).

tools.name: create_draft
tools.description: Create a NEW item (e.g. a bundle offer or a popup campaign) as a draft. Nothing changes on the store until the merchant publishes it. Use the field names from get_write_guide.

tools.name: stage_changes
tools.description: Save changes to a live item (or app settings) as UNPUBLISHED changes (a draft). The live store does not change: it keeps the current version until the change is published (publish_draft or the merchant's Publish click), and the draft can be discarded. Repeated calls for the same item update that one

tools.name: delete_item
tools.description: Delete an item (a Bundles offer, a popup campaign, a bar). The delete is saved as a draft with a preview card and happens when it is published (the merchant's Publish click, or publish_draft where AI publishing is allowed); until then the item stays live and the draft can be discarded. A published d

tools.name: edit_draft
tools.description: Change a draft or a set of unpublished changes before it is published. Only the draft changes, never the live store; values given here replace the draft's earlier values (arrays replace the whole list), so check the draft first. `changes` is partial.

tools.name: request_publish
tools.description: Ask the merchant to publish a draft. This does not publish: publishing always needs the merchant's own click (the Publish button on the preview card, or the publish link in their Shopify admin that this returns).

tools.name: discard_draft
tools.description: Throw away a draft or unpublished changes. The live store is not changed.

tools.name: request_undo
tools.description: Ask the merchant to undo a publish (put back what it replaced, or remove an item it created). This does not undo by itself: the merchant clicks Undo on the card or on the link this returns.

tools.name: card_refresh
tools.description: Preview card: reload a draft.

tools.name: find_ea_app
tools.description: Find which EA Shopify app fits what a merchant wants (e.g. a sticky add to cart bar, bundles, an email popup, translation, a free shipping bar). Works without signing in. Returns the best match(es), one line each, with a Shopify App Store install link. Doesn't read any store.

tools.name: list_ea_apps
tools.description: All 10 EA Shopify apps, what each one does, and a Shopify App Store install link for each. Works without signing in. Doesn't read any store (use list_apps for the apps installed on the connected store).

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_ea_app · Public sink: stage_changes, delete_item, request_publish, request_undo, find_ea_app · Destructive: delete_item, request_undo.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_ea_app · Public sink: stage_changes, delete_item, request_publish, request_undo, find_ea_app · Destructive: delete_item, request_undo

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
